tolerance.note: temperatures 0.5 percent (of the value in C, about 0.4 K) and the duty 1 percent, fixed before the run; the two published ranges are inclusive

scenarios.why: the same exchanger with parallel flow (the tutorial notes counter-current lets the cold outlet approach the hot inlet; parallel flow should not): independent co-current solution
twice the exchanger (U 5000 W/m2K, same area): more heat transferred, independent solution
double the cold flow (4 kg/s): the cold stream heats less and the hot stream cools more, independent solution

review.method: independent UA-mode solution with CoolProp IAPWS-95 (both energy balances and Q = UA x LMTD); published ranges transcribed
